name: nanocoder
tagline: Community terminal coding agent, local-first with a skills system
description: nanocoder is a community-driven terminal coding agent built as an alternative to vendor-locked offerings. It is local-first with Ollama support, ships with no telemetry, and uses a skills system that lets the agent acquire capabilities the way the Agent Skills ecosystem standardizes them. A per-project daemon keeps agent state and context tied to the workspace. It is positioned as the community's answer to corporate coding agents, emphasizing privacy, offline capability, and an extensible skill model.
highlights: Community-built terminal coding agent, not a corporate product
Local-first with Ollama support and zero telemetry
Skills system for extensible agent capabilities
Per-project daemon keeps agent context tied to the workspace
curatorNote: A genuinely community-owned coding agent with a local-first ethos and a skills system — a refreshing counterweight to the corporate, telemetry-heavy agents dominating the space.
